title: Blob container is publicly readable
description: Anonymous public read access is allowed on a blob container.
remediation: Set container access to Private and disable anonymous blob access on the account.

title: SSH (22) open to the internet
description: An inbound NSG rule allows 0.0.0.0/0 on TCP 22.
remediation: Restrict SSH to your /32 or use Azure Bastion instead of public SSH.

title: SQL firewall allows all IPs
remediation: Remove the allow-all rule; permit only required IPs or Azure services.

title: VM allows SSH password auth
description: The Linux VM accepts password-based SSH login.
remediation: Disable password authentication; rely on SSH keys only.

title: Storage reachable from all networks
description: Public network access is enabled on the storage account.
remediation: Disable public network access; use private endpoints or selected networks.

title: Diagnostic logging disabled on storage
description: Storage access logs are not sent to Log Analytics.
remediation: Enable diagnostic settings and route logs to Log Analytics.

title: Key Vault open to all networks
description: The Key Vault firewall is not restricting network access.
remediation: Enable the Key Vault firewall; allow only trusted services and private endpoints.

title: TDE status needs manual confirmation
description: The scanner could not confirm Transparent Data Encryption is enforced.
remediation: Confirm TDE is enabled on the SQL database (on by default).

title: No activity-log alert for config changes
description: No alert exists for security-relevant control-plane operations.
remediation: Create activity-log alerts for NSG/firewall rule changes.

title: VM has no managed identity
description: The VM authenticates without a managed identity.
remediation: Assign a system-assigned managed identity with least-privilege RBAC.
